rows.name: Umm...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
How are you? Sleep well?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Yes, very well.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I wanted to...talk about your son.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Have you made up your mind?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yes.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

We agree with you.[XENO:n ]
Egil must be stopped.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But we can't act now.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Why's that?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Before we came here, we heard of plans[XENO:n ]
to form an allied force on Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Any day now they're going to launch an[XENO:n ]
attack on Machine God. But it's too dangerous.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Egil has made a weapon that could kill us all.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]The weapon that Mumca was using?[XENO:n ]
The one that shoots green fluid?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He said it can decompose any being from Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]We have to go back and warn them.[XENO:n ]
Before it's too late.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Well, you could always ask me to do it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]Dikson-san?! What are you doing here?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I can't believe you found us.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Why? This place is directly below the fortress.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

If you fell from up there, I figured you must've[XENO:n ]
ended up here. And Bob's your uncle.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
You're looking well, Dikson.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I see you're lookin' like your usual old self.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You know each other?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Kinda.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I scratch his back, he scratches mine.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

He tells us about the outside world, and we[XENO:n ]
give him technology and information.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT16 ]Why did you keep that to yourself?[XENO:n ]
That information is vital to all who fight Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Not all of us Homs are good people. What'd happen[XENO:n ]
if the Machine God-hating types found this place?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

These Machina cut themselves off from the[XENO:n ]
world to get away from pointless fighting.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So they escaped to live in peace?[XENO:n ]
Somewhere they wouldn't be seen. Makes sense.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT2 ]Clever little crown princess, ain't ya?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

So this is where you obtained all that[XENO:n ]
stuff you brought back to Colony 9.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT18 ]I wondered where you were getting it from.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I thought it was fine as long as it[XENO:n ]
helped Shulk out at the lab.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]I guess the secret's out now.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]So, that weapon.[XENO:n ]
How dangerous are we talkin' about?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I haven't discovered why, but it[XENO:n ]
disintegrates anything it touches.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
But only if it's living tissue from Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Bet that would come in handy.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Dikson![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT9 ]I'm only jokin'. Anyway, for now just[XENO:n ]
don't let any of it touch you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]I'll come up with something to counter it.[XENO:n ]
Leave it with me and I'll keep ya posted.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You lot go and take care of that[XENO:n ]
Egil or whatever his name is.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

If you take him down, the allied force[XENO:n ]
might not even be needed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT6 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Let me think about it for a bit.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
